cmd_teste: Tests the bed of the truck you are in. Optional: mechanism (garfo, braco, escavadeira) and max tilt (5 to 100)
mecanismo_invalido: Invalid mechanism. Use: fixa, garfo, braco or escavadeira.
entre_caminhao: Get in the truck to test the bed.
plataforma_fixa: %s is set up with a fixed bed. To try another mechanism: /guinchoteste garfo (or braco, escavadeira).
testando: Testing the bed (mechanism: %s, up to %s%%). Truck locked during the test.
teste_fim: Test finished (mechanism: %s). Did the bed move?
perm_desc: Tow truck setup, points and impound lots
entre_caminhao_novo: Get in the truck you want to add and click again.
ja_cadastrado: This truck is already set up.
fique_perto: Stand near a %s (15 m) to mark or test.
vendo_pontos: Showing the marked points for 15 seconds.
ponto_vazio: The aim hit nothing: point at the truck or the ground and try again.
sem_osso: Could not find the part that moves the bed on this model. Check the mechanism in the setup.
diag_fora: Get out of the truck: the diagnosis runs from outside.
diag_sem: Stand near (15 m) a set up truck with a tilting bed.
sem_emprego: Your job does not operate this tow truck.
fora_servico: Go on duty to operate the tow truck.
cabo_ocupado: This winch cable is already in use.
cabo_curto: The cable does not reach that car: bring the truck closer.
so_vazio: Only empty vehicles can be towed.
sem_aeronave: This truck does not carry helicopters or planes.
grande_demais: This vehicle is %s m long and this truck takes up to %s m (change it in the panel).
ja_engatado: That car is already hooked to another tow truck.
carro_preso: Release the car from the bed first.
nao_e_guincho: That vehicle is not a registered tow truck.
cabo_limite: The cable reached its limit and went back to the winch.
sem_pontos: This truck has no load position and ramp marked in the panel yet.
incline_primeiro: Tilt the bed from the cab before pulling or lowering the car.
falhou_carga: Could not move the car. Try again.
caminhao_freado: Cable hooked: release it or load the car before driving off.
tombado: Overturned car: hook it in the middle to flip it.
desvirado: Car flipped upright. Unhook the cable to continue.
desvirar_caixa: Winch in to flip the car
reconheca_primeiro: Recognize the bed part in the panel before marking this point.
reconhecer_incline: Get in the cab and tilt the bed with the truck keys (up to 25 s).
reconhecer_auto: Recognizing the bed part (it will tilt and come back)...
portatil_ja_montado: You already have a portable winch set up. Pack it before setting another one.
portatil_sem_item: You do not have the portable winch.
falhou_portatil: Could not fix the winch here. Try again.
portatil_nao_e_seu: Only who set it up can pack this winch.
portatil_solte_cabo: Unhook the cable from the car before packing the winch.
portatil_sem_espaco: No room in the inventory for the winch.
portatil_sucata: The portable winch broke and is now scrap.
portatil_quebrou: Last use: the portable winch broke. Unhook the cable and pack the scrap.
portatil_restam: Car flipped back. %s uses left on the winch.
portatil_so_desvira: The portable winch only flips overturned cars.
portatil_mire: Aim at a tree trunk, pole, wall or the front of a car
portatil_em_pe: It must be a standing surface (trunk, pole or wall)
portatil_fixado: Winch fixed. Take the cable at the motor.
portatil_frente: Aim at the front of the car (front bumper)
portatil_ja_tem: This vehicle already has a built-in winch
portatil_carro_andando: Stop the car before fixing the winch.
portatil_carro_ocupado: This car already has a portable winch attached.
portatil_caiu: The car moved with the winch attached: it fell off and was lost.
arrasto_preso: The car is stuck on something and will not move.
